title: The Greedy Bishop
setup: Black's bishop has just eaten the a2-pawn and now stands in the corner of your camp on a2.
hint: Count the squares that bishop still has. Take the longer diagonal away and see what is left over.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b3}} shuts the diagonal toward g8 and leaves the bishop only b1, a square your rook covers from e1. Ra1 next move wins it. The pawn on b3 is safe because c2 defends it. A bishop that snacks on a wing pawn often cannot get home.
